text: RESULTS: The lesion is a rough, scaly plaque located on the left dorsal hand. No other visible abnormalities are present. Palpation reveals no tenderness or pain. Skin biopsy findings show hyperkeratosis with parakeratosis, solar elastosis, and atypical keratinocytes confined to the epidermis, consistent with actinic keratosis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Actinic Keratosis. The clinical presentation of a rough, scaly plaque on a sun-exposed area combined with biopsy findings of hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, solar elastosis, and atypical keratinocytes confined to the epidermis is diagnostic for this pre-malignant skin condition.
